# [BOOK] Leave Management Deep Dive Book

> [!NOTE]
> This is the long-form debugging and learning book for the Leave Management project. It is separate from `PROJECT_GUIDE.md`.

**Generated/updated:** `2026-06-03 17:52:53`

## [CURRENT] Current State Addendum - 2026-07-08

This deep dive book is very large and includes generated references from an earlier project snapshot. This addendum records the latest known current state. If a generated lower section conflicts with this addendum, verify the source code and trust this addendum first.

### [CURRENT] Current Production Architecture

```text
nginx -> gunicorn -> Django -> PostgreSQL
Django/qcluster -> background jobs
lms_scheduler -> scheduled jobs and startup catch-up
```

Production services:

```text
nginx
postgresql
gunicorn
qcluster
lms_scheduler
```

Current worker/process shape:

```text
Gunicorn: 1 master + 3 workers
qcluster: about 6 processes total, 2 real configured workers
lms_scheduler: 1 dedicated process
```

### [CURRENT] Current Scheduler Jobs

```text
startup catch-up checks on scheduler start
nightly backup daily 02:00
year-end carry-forward check daily 01:00
weekly HR report Monday 09:00
public holiday sync monthly day 1 03:00
admin email job recovery every 5 minutes
scheduler keep-alive every 6 hours
```

### [CURRENT] Current Production Fixes Already Applied

```text
Dedicated lms_scheduler.service added.
Gunicorn/qcluster/lms_scheduler PATH overrides include /usr/bin.
pg_dump/psql are available for backup/restore.
Backup cleanup removes incomplete raw .sql files.
Runtime startup timestamps use local production time behavior.
Leave approve/reject locks only the Leave row with select_for_update(of=("self",)).
Notification symbol/entity rendering issue was fixed safely.
Apply/edit leave timing rules are configurable.
Multiple leave record emails are supported.
Employee leave delete email behavior exists.
Password max-length protection is deployed.
```

### [CURRENT] Current Security And Login Rules

Password max length:

```env
PASSWORD_INPUT_MAX_LENGTH=128
```

Login lock limits:

```text
Admin:    5 wrong attempts in 15 minutes -> 30 minute lockout
HR:       5 wrong attempts in 15 minutes -> 15 minute lockout
Employee: 5 wrong attempts in 15 minutes -> 15 minute lockout
```

Production cookie security expected output:

```text
True True Lax True
```

Verification command:

```bash
python manage.py shell -c "from django.conf import settings; print(settings.SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, settings.SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY, settings.SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE, settings.CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE)"
```

### [CURRENT] Current Leave Timing Rules

```env
SHORT_HALF_LEAVE_MIN_NOTICE_MINUTES=15
SHORT_HALF_LEAVE_GRACE_MINUTES=5
SICK_LEAVE_SAME_DAY_CUTOFF_TIME=11:59
```

Meaning:

```text
Short/Half leave: 15 minute notice with 5 minute grace.
Sick leave for today: allowed through 11:59 AM, blocked from 12:00 PM.
```

### [CURRENT] Current Record Email Setting

```env
LEAVE_RECORD_EMAILS=leave@mst-india.com
```

Multiple recipients are comma-separated.

### [CURRENT] Most Important Production Lesson

```text
Do not deploy by memory.
Classify changed files -> run required commands -> restart owning services -> check logs -> verify in browser/admin.
```


## [CURRENT] Current Incident And Debug Index - 2026-07-08

Use this index for the production issues we have already seen and solved.

| Incident/problem | What it really meant | Where to debug |
|---|---|---|
| Backup failed with `pg_dump` not found | systemd service PATH missed `/usr/bin` | `manage_backups.py`, `lms_scheduler`, `gunicorn` env |
| 0 byte `.sql` backup files | failed/incomplete raw dump | backups folder, `manage_backups.py` cleanup |
| Scheduler worked in dev but not production | production needed dedicated `lms_scheduler.service` | `scheduler.py`, `run_lms_scheduler.py`, systemd |
| Public holiday sync logs after scheduler start | startup sync task was enqueued | `scheduler.py`, `public_holidays.py`, qcluster logs |
| HR approval looked like session issue | real error was PostgreSQL `FOR UPDATE` nullable join | `approve_leave`, `reject_leave` |
| Notification showed HTML entity code | escaped symbol was rendered as text | notification JS/template rendering |
| Static UI fix did not show | `collectstatic` or browser cache missing | static source, `staticfiles`, nginx/browser |
| Admin backup failed but terminal worked | Gunicorn PATH differed from terminal PATH | `systemctl show gunicorn -p Environment` |
| qcluster shows 6 processes | normal for 2 configured workers plus guard/monitor/pusher | `settings.Q_CLUSTER`, qcluster status |
| Direct IP DisallowedHost logs | bot/wrong-host request blocked correctly | gunicorn logs, `ALLOWED_HOSTS` |
| Long password attack concern | max password input length added | `App/scripts/validators.py`, login templates, forms/admin |
| Linux felt slow | extra terminal tools/accounts-daemon/swap needed checking | `uptime`, `free -h`, `ps`, system services |

### [CURRENT] Debug Pattern For Any Future Incident

```text
1. Capture exact time and user action.
2. Decide owner: gunicorn, qcluster, lms_scheduler, nginx, postgresql, or OS.
3. Read that service log first.
4. Search exact error in this book and code.
5. Check if production has the expected file version.
6. Fix smallest owning file/service.
7. Run manage.py check.
8. Restart owning service.
9. Verify same failing action.
10. Add incident notes to PROJECT_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md.
```

### [CURRENT] Feature Documentation Pattern

Every feature should be understandable at four levels:

```text
README.md: what the feature is.
PROJECT_GUIDE.md: how users/admins use it.
PROJECT_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md: how to deploy/restart/verify it.
PROJECT_DEEP_DIVE_BOOK.md: how to debug it deeply.
```

## [SECTION] How To Use This Book

```text
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
HOW TO USE THIS BOOK
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

-> **Step 1:** Search by exact function, class, file, model, service, or error text.
-> **Step 2:** When a bug happens, write down user action, expected behavior, actual behavior, and timestamp.
-> **Step 3:** Use service logs to identify the owning process before editing code.
-> **Step 4:** Use this file to understand the likely flow, then open the actual source code.
-> **Step 5:** Do not treat this file as proof that production has the latest code; verify with `grep` or logs.

> [!TIP]
> Debugging is faster when you know which service owns the code path before changing anything.

## [SECTION] Architecture Story

```text
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ARCHITECTURE STORY
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

-> **Step 1:** The browser talks to Django views and API endpoints.
-> **Step 2:** Django views validate requests and call service functions.
-> **Step 3:** Models store persistent database state.
-> **Step 4:** Admin classes expose management workflows, confirmation pages, and audit logs.
-> **Step 5:** Background tasks use qcluster first and thread fallback second.
-> **Step 6:** Scheduled jobs run from the dedicated lms_scheduler service.
-> **Step 7:** Backups use manage_backups.py and external PostgreSQL tools.

> [!TIP]
> Debugging is faster when you know which service owns the code path before changing anything.

## [SECTION] Production Story

```text
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRODUCTION STORY
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

-> **Step 1:** nginx owns HTTPS, static/media serving, and reverse proxy behavior.
-> **Step 2:** gunicorn owns Django web/admin/API requests.
-> **Step 3:** postgresql owns database state.
-> **Step 4:** qcluster owns queued background jobs.
-> **Step 5:** lms_scheduler owns scheduled checks and scheduled side effects.
-> **Step 6:** The systemd PATH must keep venv first and include /usr/bin for tools.

> [!TIP]
> Debugging is faster when you know which service owns the code path before changing anything.

## [SECTION] Debugging Strategy

```text
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DEBUGGING STRATEGY
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

-> **Step 1:** Classify the problem: web request, background job, scheduled job, static file, DB state, email, or external tool.
-> **Step 2:** Check logs for the owning service.
-> **Step 3:** Check database/audit/email rows for the same timestamp.
-> **Step 4:** Search this book and the source code by function name.
-> **Step 5:** Make the smallest fix and verify with the original failing action.

> [!TIP]
> Debugging is faster when you know which service owns the code path before changing anything.

- [OK] Verify production loaded the changed file.

- ! Background/email/file work can behave differently under systemd than in your terminal.
- ! A UI message can hide the real backend traceback, so always read logs.

#### [VERIFY] Production Verification

1. Copy/deploy the changed source file.
2. Run `python manage.py check` if this is Python code.
3. Restart the owning service.
4. Check logs.

# [PART G] Extended Study Notes

# [PART H] Practical Operations Handbook

This part turns the raw function reference into real operating knowledge. Use it when you do not just want to know "where is the function", but want to know:

```text
What happens first?
Which file runs next?
Which table changes?
Which service owns the action?
Which log proves it worked?
What can break?
How do I safely test it?
```

The earlier function reference is for searching. This part is for understanding the full story.

## [SECTION] Real User Journey Chapters

### [FLOW] Employee Applies Sick Leave

```text
Employee browser
-> apply_leave page
-> POST apply_leave
-> App/views.py apply_leave()
-> validation helpers
-> leave_breakdown service
-> Leave row created
-> LeaveBalance updated
-> HR notification prepared
-> email/push side effects queued
-> employee sees result
```

Important files:

```text
App/views.py
App/models.py
App/services/leave_breakdown.py
App/services/background_tasks.py
templates/apply_leave.html
static/js/apply_leave.js
```

Important functions:

```text
apply_leave()
calculate_leave_breakdown()
expand_full_day_leave_range()
queue_hr_leave_push()
send_branded_email()
enqueue_background_task()
```

What is validated:

```text
user is logged in
user role is EMPLOYEE
leave type is allowed
date range is valid
reason is within limit
overlap rules are checked
company holiday rules are checked
balance/deduction can be calculated
```

Example:

```text
User: anurag
Leave type: Sick
From: 2026-06-10
To: 2026-06-12
Reason: Medical appointment and recovery
Expected result: Pending leave row, sick balance deducted/reserved, HR notification created
```

Database rows to inspect:

```text
App_leave
App_leavebalance
App_leavenotificationread
App_leavenotificationseen
App_emaildeliverylog
django_q_ormq
```

Logs to inspect:

```bash
sudo journalctl -u gunicorn -n 200 --no-pager
sudo journalctl -u qcluster -n 100 --no-pager
```

Common failures:

```text
Wrong role -> redirect or forbidden
Invalid date/time -> validation error
Overlap -> blocked
Balance issue -> leave not created or balance mismatch
qcluster stopped -> fallback thread may run
static old -> browser may show old UI
```

How to test:

1. Login as employee.
2. Apply Sick leave.
3. Confirm row appears in My Leave as Pending.
4. Login as HR.
5. Confirm HR notification shows pending request.
6. Check email/push if configured.

### [FLOW] Employee Applies Short Leave

```text
Employee browser
-> apply_leave page
-> choose Short
-> date and time fields required
-> POST apply_leave
-> Leave.clean() validates short rules
-> system checks monthly count
-> leave value is 0.25
```

Important rules:

```text
Short leave is same day only.
Short leave must be inside 10 AM to 7 PM.
Short leave max duration is 2 hours.
Only 2 Short leaves are allowed per month.
Short leave does not use WFH bridge rules.
Short leave value is 0.25 day.
```

Important model logic:

```text
Leave.clean()
Leave.save()
```

Example:

```text
Date: 2026-06-10
From: 04:00 PM
To: 05:30 PM
Duration: 1.5 hours
Expected value: 0.25 day
```

Common failures:

```text
time missing
duration greater than 2 hours
from/to date not same
outside working hours
already used 2 Short leaves in same month
```

Debug query:

```bash
python manage.py shell -c "from App.models import Leave; print(list(Leave.objects.filter(user__username='USERNAME', leave_type='Short').values('id','from_date','status')))"
```

### [FLOW] Employee Applies Half Leave

Important rules:

```text
Half leave is same day only.
Half leave must be inside 10 AM to 7 PM.
Half leave max duration is 4 hours.
Only 1 Half leave is allowed per month.
Half leave does not use WFH bridge rules.
Half leave value is 0.5 day.
```

Example:

```text
Date: 2026-06-10
From: 02:00 PM
To: 06:00 PM
Duration: 4 hours
Expected value: 0.5 day
```

Debug focus:

```text
Leave.clean()
monthly count query
LeaveBalance update
my_leave display
HR notification display
```

### [FLOW] HR Approves Leave

```text
HR browser
-> manage_all or HR dashboard
-> click approve
-> POST /approve-leave/<id>/
-> approve_leave()
-> transaction.atomic()
-> select_for_update(of=("self"))
-> leave status becomes Approved
-> reviewed_by set to HR
-> approved_at set
-> employee notification/email/push queued
```

Important files:

```text
App/views.py
App/services/background_tasks.py
templates/manage_all.html
static/js/manage_all.js
```

Important safety fix:

```python
Leave.objects.select_for_update(of=("self")).select_related("user", "user__profile")
```

Why it is used:

```text
The Leave row must be locked so two HR/admin operations cannot approve/reject the same leave at the same time.
Only the Leave row is locked, because locking nullable profile joins caused PostgreSQL errors.
```

Expected database changes:

```text
Leave.status: Pending -> Approved
Leave.approved_at: set
Leave.rejected_at: cleared
Leave.reviewed_by: HR user
```

What should not happen:

```text
LeaveBalance should not be deducted again on approval, because balance was already handled at apply time.
```

Common failures:

```text
leave already approved/rejected -> 409 or warning
user is not HR -> forbidden/redirect
PostgreSQL lock issue -> check select_for_update
AJAX stale state -> static JS or API response issue
```

### [FLOW] HR Rejects Leave

```text
HR browser
-> click reject
-> enter rejection reason
-> POST /reject-leave/<id>/
-> reject_leave()
-> validate reason
-> lock Leave row
-> lock LeaveBalance row
-> restore/reconcile balance
-> set status Rejected
-> set rejected_at and reviewed_by
-> employee notification/email/push queued
```

Important details:

```text
Rejection reason is required.
Rejection reason must be 500 characters or fewer.
Only Pending leave can be rejected.
Balance is restored/reconciled when rejection changes leave state.
```

Debug focus:

```text
Leave.status
Leave.rejection_reason
LeaveBalance totals
logs for balance restoration messages
employee notification feed
EmailDeliveryLog
```

### [FLOW] Admin Edits Leave

Admin leave edits are more powerful than HR actions. They can repair, sync, approve/reject, delete, recalculate, and override WFH bridge behavior.

Admin edit flow:

```text
Admin opens Leave in Django admin
-> changes fields
-> enters audit reason
-> admin form validates
-> save_model/save_related logic runs
-> audit log records old/new values
-> notification read/seen can be reset if important fields changed
```

Important files:

```text
App/admin.py
App/services/admin_leave_workflow.py
templates/admin/leave_change_form.html
```

When admin changes important pending leave details:

```text
HR notification can be refreshed.
Read/seen state can reset.
HR can see updated request as new/unread again.
```

Debug focus:

```text
LeaveAdmin
LeaveAdminForm
_create_admin_audit_log()
refresh_pending_leave_notification()
LeaveAdminAudit
```

### [FLOW] Admin Creates User

```text
Admin opens Users
-> Add user
-> selects role
-> fills login and profile data
-> optional welcome package/email
-> saves
-> CustomUser row created
-> Profile row created/updated
-> optional LeaveBalance for employee where applicable
-> audit recorded
```

Important distinction:

```text
Admin/HR may have profile rows, but employee-specific balance/profile behavior can differ by role.
Welcome email/package is optional.
```

Debug focus:

```text
CustomUser.role
Profile.role
employee_id
LeaveBalance exists or not
EmailDeliveryLog
AdminAuditLog
```

### [FLOW] Admin Sends Onboarding Email

```text
Admin selects users
-> action Resend onboarding email
-> confirmation page previews each user
-> eligible users queued
-> AdminEmailJob created
-> AdminEmailJobItem created per user
-> qcluster sends each item
-> EmailDeliveryLog updated
-> job status page auto-refreshes
```

Possible preview outcomes:

```text
Has email -> will queue
No email -> skipped
No profile -> skipped
Already sent -> resend allowed because this action is resend
```

Debug focus:

```text
AdminEmailJob
AdminEmailJobItem
EmailDeliveryLog
employee_welcome_service.py
qcluster logs
```

### [FLOW] Admin Locks User Login

```text
Admin selects user
-> action Lock login
-> confirmation page shows current status
-> admin enters reason/duration/email choice
-> lock_user_login()
-> cache manual lock key set
-> audit recorded
-> optional AdminEmailJob lock email queued
```

Where lock lives:

```text
cache key, not a permanent database field
```

This means:

```text
If cache is cleared, temporary lock state can reset.
Audit records still remain.
```

Debug focus:

```text
login_lock_service.py
cache keys
security/auth logs
AdminEmailJob if email was selected
```

### [FLOW] Admin Unlocks User Login

```text
Admin selects user
-> action Unlock login
-> confirmation page shows locked/already clear state
-> unlock_user_login()
-> manual/wrong-password/IP lock keys deleted
-> audit recorded
-> optional unlock email queued
```

Expected message example:

```text
Login unlock completed. Cleared: 1. Already clear: 0.
```

If selected user is already clear:

```text
No lock keys deleted.
User is reported as already clear.
No meaningful state change happens.
```

### [FLOW] Admin Runs Backup

```text
Admin Service Actions
-> type RUN_BACKUP
-> gunicorn imports manage_backups.run_backup()
-> pg_dump creates raw .sql
-> compress_file creates .zip
-> raw .sql removed
-> success shown and logged
```

Debug focus:

```text
manage_backups.py
pg_dump path
gunicorn PATH
backups directory
logs/backups/activity.log
```

### [FLOW] Scheduler Runs Nightly Backup

```text
lms_scheduler wakes at 02:00
-> check_and_run_missed_backup()
-> get_backup_catchup_status()
-> if no .zip for today, run_backup()
-> pg_dump -> raw .sql -> .zip
-> log BACKUP | SUCCESS
```

Verify:

```bash
ls -lh ~/Leave_Management_MST/backups | tail -10
sudo journalctl -u lms_scheduler --since "YYYY-MM-DD 01:55:00" --no-pager
```

## [SECTION] Error Dictionary

### [ERROR] `FOR UPDATE cannot be applied to the nullable side of an outer join`

Cause:

```text
PostgreSQL does not allow row locking on nullable joined tables from an outer join.
```

Where it happened:

```text
approve_leave()
reject_leave()
```

Fix pattern:

```python
select_for_update(of=("self")).select_related("user", "user__profile")
```

How to debug:

```bash
sudo journalctl -u gunicorn -n 200 --no-pager
```

### [ERROR] `No such file or directory: 'pg_dump'`

Cause:

```text
Service PATH did not include /usr/bin, even though terminal could find pg_dump.
```

Fix:

```text
Add full PATH override to gunicorn and lms_scheduler.
```

Check:

```bash
which pg_dump
sudo systemctl show gunicorn -p Environment
sudo systemctl show lms_scheduler -p Environment
```

### [ERROR] `No such file or directory: 'psql'`

Cause:

```text
Restore needs psql and service/terminal PATH must find it.
```

Check:

```bash
which psql
psql --version
```

### [ERROR] `value too long for type character varying(...)`

Cause:

```text
Text longer than DB column max_length.
```

Known fix:

```text
Audit/email fields capped/truncated and max lengths increased where needed.
```

Debug:

```text
Find traceback line.
Find model field max_length.
Check value being saved.
Either truncate before save or migrate field length.
```

### [ERROR] Static JS change not visible

Cause:

```text
collectstatic not run or browser cached old file.
```

Fix:

```bash
python manage.py collectstatic
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
```

Browser:

```text
Hard refresh.
Check Network tab for loaded static file.
```

### [ERROR] qcluster stopped

Symptoms:

```text
Admin email job stays queued.
Background email/push delayed.
Recovery may not process.
```

Check:

```bash
sudo systemctl status qcluster
pgrep -fc "manage.py qcluster"
```

Fix:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
```

### [ERROR] Playwright Chromium missing

Symptoms:

```text
Weekly report PDF fails.
PDF generator fails.
```

Check:

```bash
python -c "from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright; p=sync_playwright().start(); b=p.chromium.launch(headless=True); print('playwright chromium ok'); b.close(); p.stop()"
```

Fix:

```bash
python -m playwright install chromium
```

### [ERROR] Email sent but user did not receive

Possible causes:

```text
SMTP failed
recipient email wrong
email in spam/quarantine
qcluster job failed
EmailDeliveryLog says failed
```

Check:

```text
EmailDeliveryLog
AdminEmailJobItem
qcluster logs
SMTP settings
```

### [ERROR] Browser notification sound not playing

Possible causes:

```text
tab closed
polling stopped
notification already read/seen
browser blocks sound
static JS old
push permission missing
```

Check:

```text
browser console
API polling response
read/seen tables
push subscription
collectstatic
```

### [ERROR] Session expired but logs show internal server error

Cause:

```text
UI message can be misleading.
The backend may have thrown a real exception.
```

Correct check:

```bash
sudo journalctl -u gunicorn -n 200 --no-pager
```

## [SECTION] Service Ownership Matrix

| Feature | nginx | gunicorn | postgresql | qcluster | lms_scheduler |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Login pages | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Admin panel | yes | yes | yes | maybe | no |
| Employee apply leave | yes | yes | yes | yes for side effects | no |
| HR approve/reject | yes | yes | yes | yes for side effects | no |
| Communication feed | yes | yes | yes | yes for push | no |
| Browser push subscribe | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Admin bulk email jobs | yes | yes | yes | yes | recovery only |
| Scheduled backup | no | no | yes | no | yes |
| Manual admin backup | yes | yes | yes | no | no |
| Weekly HR report scheduled | no | maybe email render | yes | maybe | yes |
| Public holiday sync startup/monthly | no | no | yes/cache file | yes startup task | yes |
| Static files | yes | no after collected | no | no | no |
| Media/profile photos | yes | yes upload | yes metadata | no | no |

Rule:

```text
If browser request starts it, gunicorn is involved.
If a selected admin email is queued, qcluster is involved.
If time triggers it, lms_scheduler is involved.
If data is stored, postgresql is involved.
If public URL/static/media is involved, nginx is involved.
```

## [SECTION] Code Change Safety Rules

### [RULE] When To Add Audit Log

Add or confirm audit logging when code changes:

```text
user account
profile
leave
leave balance
holiday
WFH day
communication
backup/restore
maintenance mode
admin workflow
email job state
```

Why:

```text
Admin must know who changed what, when, and why.
```

### [RULE] When To Reset Read/Seen

Reset read/seen state when:

```text
message content changes
announcement content changes
pending leave details change
notification should become visible again
```

Do not reset read/seen when:

```text
minor internal metadata changes
admin-only audit fields change
already completed notification should remain historical
```

### [RULE] When To Queue Background Task

Queue background task when:

```text
email sending could slow request
push notification can fail independently
bulk admin action processes many users
external network call is not needed to render page immediately
```

Do not queue when:

```text
result must be known before saving transaction
small DB update must happen immediately
admin needs immediate validation error
```

### [RULE] When To Use `transaction.atomic`

Use transaction when:

```text
multiple database rows must change together
leave and balance both change
job and job items created together
audit should match state change
```

Example:

```python
with transaction.atomic():
    leave = Leave.objects.select_for_update(of=("self")).get(id=leave_id)
    leave.status = "Approved"
    leave.save(...)
```

### [RULE] When To Use `select_for_update`

Use row locking when:

```text
two people could update same leave/balance/job at same time
balance recalculation must not race
job recovery should not clash with active worker
```

Avoid locking nullable joined tables:

```python
select_for_update(of=("self"))
```

### [RULE] When To Truncate Long Text

Truncate before saving to short fields when:

```text
value comes from user input
value comes from generated action name
value comes from JSON/message/reason
DB field is CharField(max_length=...)
```

Known reason:

```text
prevents value too long for type character varying(...)
```

### [RULE] When To Create Migration

Create migration when:

```text
model field added/removed
field max_length changed
field default changed in model
new model added
database constraint changed
```

No migration needed when:

```text
view logic changes
admin action logic changes
template changes
static JS/CSS changes
service function logic changes without model field changes
```

## [SECTION] Production Recovery Runbooks

### [RUNBOOK] qcluster Down

Symptoms:

```text
bulk email jobs stay queued
background emails delayed
push notifications delayed
```

Recovery:

```bash
sudo systemctl status qcluster
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
sudo systemctl status qcluster
pgrep -fc "manage.py qcluster"
```

Then:

```bash
python manage.py shell -c "from App.services.admin_bulk_email_jobs import recover_stuck_admin_email_jobs; print(recover_stuck_admin_email_jobs())"
```

Done when:

```text
qcluster active
process count normal
job items progress
```

### [RUNBOOK] lms_scheduler Down

Symptoms:

```text
nightly backup missed
weekly report missed
admin email recovery not running
keepalive logs missing
```

Recovery:

```bash
sudo systemctl status lms_scheduler
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
sudo journalctl -u lms_scheduler -n 100 --no-pager
```

Done when:

```text
SCHEDULER | STARTED
JOB_ADDED lines visible
Keep-alive later appears
```

### [RUNBOOK] Backup Failed

Check:

```bash
ls -lh ~/Leave_Management_MST/backups | tail -10
sudo journalctl -u lms_scheduler --since "YYYY-MM-DD 01:55:00" --no-pager
which pg_dump
sudo systemctl show lms_scheduler -p Environment
```

If raw `.sql` remains:

```text
Check size.
If 0 bytes and no matching .zip, it is failed leftover.
Current code should remove it automatically after failure.
```

Recovery:

```text
fix pg_dump/PATH issue
restart lms_scheduler
run manual backup from admin if safe
confirm .zip created
```

### [RUNBOOK] gunicorn/Web Down

Check:

```bash
sudo systemctl status gunicorn
sudo journalctl -u gunicorn -n 200 --no-pager
```

Recovery:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
sudo systemctl status gunicorn
```

If code deploy caused it:

```text
run python manage.py check
check syntax/traceback
reload previous known good file if needed
```

### [RUNBOOK] Static Broken

Symptoms:

```text
old UI
button not working
JS fix not visible
password eye toggle old behavior
notification symbol issue returned
```

Recovery:

```bash
cd ~/Leave_Management_MST
source venv/bin/activate
python manage.py collectstatic
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
```

Browser:

```text
hard refresh
clear cache if needed
check Network tab
```

### [RUNBOOK] Email Stopped

Check:

```text
EmailDeliveryLog
AdminEmailJob
AdminEmailJobItem
qcluster status
SMTP settings
recipient email
```

Commands:

```bash
sudo systemctl status qcluster
sudo journalctl -u qcluster -n 100 --no-pager
```

Recovery:

```text
restart qcluster
check SMTP credentials
retry/admin resend if appropriate
```

### [RUNBOOK] Database Restore Needed

Warning:

```text
Restore overwrites current database state.
Use only in maintenance window.
```

Steps:

```text
1. Enable maintenance mode.
2. Confirm latest valid backup .zip exists.
3. Ensure psql works.
4. Use admin Backup Restore.
5. Type exact confirmation.
6. Provide reason.
7. Verify app.
8. Disable maintenance mode.
```

Check:

```bash
which psql
ls -lh ~/Leave_Management_MST/backups | tail -10
```

## [SECTION] 1. Production Command Cheat Sheet

### [COMMANDS] Always Start Here

Use this when you SSH into production.

```bash
cd ~/Leave_Management_MST
source venv/bin/activate
pwd
python manage.py check
```

Expected:

```text
System check identified no issues
```

If `python manage.py check` fails, do not restart services blindly. Read the error first.

### [COMMANDS] Check Which Files Changed In GitHub

Use after `git fetch origin`.

```bash
git fetch origin
git show --name-only --pretty=format:"%h %s" origin/main
```

Meaning:

```text
git fetch origin
    downloads the latest remote commit metadata into origin/main.

git show --name-only origin/main
    shows the latest commit title and the files changed in that commit.
```

Use this before copying files from `origin/main`.

### [COMMANDS] Copy One File From GitHub Into Production Tree

Production repository has the real app at root, while GitHub paths include `Leave Management/...`.

Example:

```bash
git show origin/main:"Leave Management/App/views.py" > App/views.py
```

Meaning:

```text
Take App/views.py from the latest GitHub main branch
and overwrite the production App/views.py file.
```

Use carefully:

```text
Only copy the files listed by git show --name-only.
Do not copy random files.
Do not run from home directory.
Run from ~/Leave_Management_MST.
```

### [COMMANDS] Check App After Copying Files

```bash
python manage.py check
```

If models or migrations changed:

```bash
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py check
```

If static files changed:

```bash
python manage.py collectstatic
```

Then restart needed services:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
```

If background jobs/services changed:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
```

Gunicorn:

```bash
sudo systemctl is-enabled gunicorn
```

Q Cluster:

```bash
sudo systemctl is-enabled qcluster
```


Q Cluster:



### [COMMANDS] Backup Checks

List backups:

```bash
ls -lh ~/Leave_Management_MST/backups | tail -20
```


```text
}

```

### [COMMANDS] Superuser Repair

Use only after DB reset or if admin cannot login.

```bash
python manage.py shell -c "from django.utils import timezone; from App.models import CustomUser, Profile; u=CustomUser.objects.get(username='mst_leave_admin'); u.role='Admin'; u.is_staff=True; u.is_superuser=True; u.must_change_password=False; u.is_active=True; u.save(); Profile.objects.update_or_create(user=u, defaults={'role':'Admin','department':'Management','date_of_joining':timezone.localdate(),'employee_id':'MST_Admin-0001'}); print('Admin fixed:', u.username, u.role, u.is_staff, u.is_superuser, u.is_active)"
```

Meaning:

## [SECTION] 2. Role And Permission Matrix

### [MATRIX] High Level Roles

| Area | Admin | HR | Employee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Django admin login | Yes | Usually no | No |
| Admin panel models | Yes | No | No |
| Employee dashboard | No, unless role flow allows | No | Yes |
| HR dashboard | No, unless role flow allows | Yes | No |
| Apply leave | Usually employee flow | Usually no | Yes |
| Approve leave | Admin via admin/edit tools, HR via HR flow | Yes | No |
| Reject leave | Admin via admin/edit tools, HR via HR flow | Yes | No |
| Edit leave from admin | Yes | No | No |
| View own profile | Yes if profile exists | Yes | Yes |
| Update own profile | Depends on profile view rules | Depends on profile view rules | Yes |
| Direct messages | Yes in admin center | Yes | Yes |
| Announcements | Yes | Yes if allowed by UI/service | No normal create flow |
| System backup | Yes | No | No |
| Restore backup | Yes with confirmation | No | No |
| Force password | Yes | No | No |
| Lock/unlock users | Yes | No | No |
| Deactivate users | Yes | No | No |

### [VERIFY] How To Verify A Permission In Code

Search these patterns:

```bash
rg -n "request.user.role|is_staff|is_superuser|login_required|user_passes_test|role ==" "Leave Management/App"
```

In production tree:

```bash
rg -n "request.user.role|is_staff|is_superuser|login_required|user_passes_test|role ==" App
```

What to inspect:

```text
1. Is the view decorated with login_required?
2. Does the view check request.user.role?
3. Does the view check is_staff or is_superuser?
4. Does the template hide or show controls based on role?
5. Does the API validate permissions again on the server?
```

Important:

```text
Template hiding is not enough security.
The server-side view/API must enforce permissions.
```

### [ROLE] Admin

Admin is the system owner role.

Admin can:

```text
create users
edit users
activate/deactivate users
force password change
clear force password change
lock/unlock login
send onboarding email
send reminders
edit admin communication center items
edit/delete announcements where admin model allows it
edit/delete direct messages where admin model allows it
run backup
restore backup
view audit logs
use service console
change leave records in admin
```

Admin must be audited when changing sensitive data.

### [ROLE] HR

HR is the leave reviewer role.

HR can:

```text
view HR dashboard
view/manage employee leave requests
approve leave
reject leave
communicate with employees
receive pending leave notifications
hear notification sound if browser tab is open and polling
```

HR should not:

```text
run backups
restore backups
change system settings
force password changes
change admin-only audit records
```

### [ROLE] Employee

Employee is the leave requester role.

Employee can:

```text
apply leave
edit/cancel leave where rules allow
view own leave status
view own profile
receive notifications
communicate with HR/admin where allowed
change forced password
```

Employee should not:

```text
approve leave
reject leave
edit another user's profile
view admin logs
run system services
```

## [SECTION] 3. Admin Action Matrix

### [MATRIX] User Admin Actions

| Admin action | Changes DB | Sends email | Uses qcluster | Audit expected | Confirmation page |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Activate selected users | Yes | Optional/job based if implemented | Yes for bulk email jobs | Yes | Yes |
| Deactivate selected users | Yes | Optional/job based if implemented | Yes for bulk email jobs | Yes | Yes |
| Force password change | Yes | Optional/job based | Yes for bulk selected email | Yes | Yes |
| Clear force password change | Yes | Optional/job based | Yes for bulk selected email | Yes | Yes |
| Login lock | Yes | Optional/job based | Yes for bulk selected email | Yes | Yes |
| Login unlock | Yes | Optional/job based | Yes for bulk selected email | Yes | Yes |
| Resend onboarding email | No user status change, email log changes | Yes | Yes | Yes/action log | Yes |
| Send reminder email | No user status change, email log changes | Yes | Yes | Yes/action log | Yes |

### [MATRIX] Communication Admin Actions

| Action | Changes DB | Re-notifies users | Sound can play | Audit expected |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Edit direct message | Yes | Yes, for incoming recipient | Yes if recipient tab is open/polling | Yes |
| Delete direct message | Yes/delete | Depends on implementation | No normal new-message sound | Yes |
| Edit announcement | Yes | Yes if refresh/re-notify implemented | Yes if tab is open/polling | Yes |
| Delete announcement | Yes/delete | Usually no new notification | No normal new-message sound | Yes |
| Admin custom notification | Yes if model/action exists | Yes | Yes if polling/browser allowed | Yes |

### [MATRIX] Leave Admin Actions

| Action | Changes Leave | Refreshes notification | Read/seen reset | Risk |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Admin edits pending leave date/time | Yes | Yes if save hook calls refresh | Yes when important details change | User sees updated pending notification |
| Admin edits approved leave | Yes | Depends on status logic | Depends on status/status change | Could affect balances |
| Admin changes approved/rejected back to pending | Yes | Pending notification should refresh for HR | Yes if implemented | HR should see it again |
| Admin deletes leave | Yes/delete | Depends on delete hooks | Not applicable | Balance and audit must be checked |

### [MATRIX] System Admin Actions

| Action | Service/tool needed | Main risk | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|
| Run backup | `pg_dump`, DB access | PATH or DB credential failure | Backup `.zip` created |
| Restore backup | `psql`, DB access | Data overwrite | App works after restore |
| Collect static | Django staticfiles | Old JS/CSS if skipped | Browser sees new JS/CSS |
| Restart gunicorn | systemd | Short app restart | `systemctl status gunicorn` |
| Restart qcluster | systemd | Queued jobs pause briefly | `systemctl status qcluster` |
| Restart scheduler | systemd | Scheduler restarts jobs | `systemctl status lms_scheduler` |

### [ADMIN] Confirmation Page Rules

A good confirmation page should show:

```text
selected user
email address
current status
what will happen
what will be skipped
reason box
send email yes/no option where relevant
final submit button
```

This prevents the admin from clicking an action blindly.

## [SECTION] 4. Email And Notification Examples

### [EMAIL] Onboarding Email

When:

```text
Admin creates user and chooses welcome package.
Admin uses resend onboarding email action.
Bulk onboarding action is run.
```

Example body:

```text
Subject: Welcome to Leave Management

Hello Anurag Singh,

Your Leave Management account has been created.

Username: anurag
Portal: https://mstleave.mstlabs.in

Please login and update your password if required.
```

Records to check:

```text
EmailDeliveryLog
AdminEmailJob
AdminEmailJobItem
```

### [EMAIL] Force Password Email

When:

```text
Admin marks must_change_password=True.
Admin chooses to notify the user.
```

Example body:

```text
Subject: Password change required

Hello Anurag Singh,

Your account requires a password update before you can continue.

Please login to the Leave Management portal and change your password.
```

Expected behavior:

```text
User logs in.
System redirects to forced password change page.
Password fields are hidden by default.
Eye buttons toggle visibility.
Rules hide while confirm password is active.
```

### [EMAIL] Wrong Password Lockout Email

When:

```text
User enters wrong password repeatedly until login lock threshold is reached.
```

Example body:

```text

Hello Anurag Singh,

Your account was temporarily locked because multiple incorrect password attempts were detected.

Lock duration: 15 minutes
Retry after: 26/05/2026 06:20 PM

If this was not you, contact the administrator.
```

Important:

```text
Automatic unlock after time does not necessarily send an unlock email unless code explicitly does it.
```

```text
Admin manually locks selected users and chooses to send email.
```

Example body:

```text

Hello Anurag Singh,

Your Leave Management account has been locked by an administrator.

Reason: Security review
Lock duration: Until administrator unlocks it

Please contact HR/Admin for help.
```

### [EMAIL] Admin Unlock Email

When:

```text
Admin unlocks selected users and chooses to send email.
```

Example body:

```text
Subject: Your account has been unlocked

Hello Anurag Singh,

Your Leave Management account has been unlocked by an administrator.

You can now login again.
```

### [EMAIL] Reminder Email

When:

```text
Admin selects users and sends reminder.
```

Example body:

```text
Subject: Leave Management reminder

Hello Anurag Singh,

This is a reminder from the Leave Management system.

Message:
Please complete your profile details.
```

### [EMAIL] Weekly HR Report

When:

```text
lms_scheduler triggers weekly report job.
qcluster/background task sends report email.
```

Dependencies:

```text
Playwright Chromium
SMTP settings
qcluster
weekly report service
```

### [EMAIL] Backup Failure Alert

When:

```text
Nightly backup fails.
Startup backup catch-up fails.
Admin backup fails and alert is configured.
```

Example body:

```text

The Leave Management backup failed.

Error: pg_dump not found
Server: mstleave-VM
Time: 30/05/2026 02:00 AM
```

```text
Employee applies leave.
HR receives pending leave notification.
```

Example:

```text
Anurag Singh applied Sick Leave
May 27, 04:59 PM - 06:59 PM

```


When:


Example rejected:


When:


Important:

```text
For a direct message, the edited message is incoming for the recipient.
That recipient should see unread/new state again if the reset logic ran.
```

## [SECTION] 5. Database Relationship Map

### [MAP] Main User Chain

```text
CustomUser
  -> Profile
  -> Leave
  -> LeaveBalance
  -> Notifications
  -> EmailDeliveryLog
  -> AdminEmailJobItem
```

### [MODEL] CustomUser

Purpose:

```text
Authentication identity.
Stores username, email, role, active/staff/superuser flags, must_change_password, login lock fields.
```

Common links:

```text
CustomUser.profile
CustomUser.leave_set
CustomUser.emaildeliverylog_set
```

Production risk:

```text
If role/staff/superuser flags are wrong, admin may not login or user may go to wrong dashboard.
```

### [MODEL] Profile

Purpose:

```text
Business identity.
Stores department, employee ID, joining date, photo, mobile, and role-related profile details.
```

Relationship:

```text
One CustomUser should normally have one Profile.
```

Production risk:

```text
Some joins treat profile as nullable.
That is why PostgreSQL select_for_update with user__profile can fail unless locking only self.
```

### [MODEL] Leave

Purpose:

```text
Stores leave request details.
Includes user, leave type, status, dates/times, reason, rejection reason, approval fields.
```

Related systems:

```text
leave balance
notifications
audit logs
HR dashboard
employee dashboard
admin leave workflow
WFH bridge
```

### [MODEL] LeaveBalance

Purpose:

```text
Stores available/used leave counts.
```

Related systems:

```text
approval/rejection
year-end carry forward
admin adjustment
balance history
```

### [MODEL] AdminAuditLog

Purpose:

```text
Records admin changes with reason and metadata.
```

Important:

```text
String fields were increased to 500 and should truncate safely to avoid varchar crashes.
```

### [MODEL] EmailDeliveryLog

Purpose:

```text
Records email sending result.
```

Used for:

```text
welcome email status
sent count
failed/skipped tracking
admin user list display
debugging SMTP issues
```

### [MODEL] AdminEmailJob And AdminEmailJobItem

Purpose:

```text
Tracks bulk email jobs.
Job = parent summary.
Item = per-user delivery status.
```

Flow:

```text
Admin action creates job.
Items created for each selected user.
qcluster/fallback processes job.
Admin job page polls status.
Scheduler recovery requeues stale running jobs.
```

### [MODEL] PushSubscription

Purpose:

```text
Stores browser push subscription endpoint and keys.
```

Production requirements:

```text
HTTPS
valid service worker
valid webpush keys
browser permission
```

## [SECTION] 6. Deployment Decision Guide

### [DECISION] If `.py` File Changed

Examples:

```text
App/views.py
App/admin.py
App/services/*.py
leave_management/settings.py
manage_backups.py
```

Run:

```bash
python manage.py check
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
```

If the file affects background jobs:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
```

### [DECISION] If `models.py` Changed

Run:

```bash
python manage.py makemigrations
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py check
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
```

Production note:

```text
If migration file is already pushed, do not run makemigrations in production.
Run migrate only.
```

### [DECISION] If Migration File Changed

Run:

```bash
python manage.py showmigrations App
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py check
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
```

If qcluster jobs use the changed model:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
```

### [DECISION] If Template Changed

Examples:

```text
templates/*.html
templates/admin/*.html
templates/emails/*.html
```

Run:

```bash
python manage.py check
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
```

No `collectstatic` needed unless static files changed too.

### [DECISION] If Static JS/CSS Changed

Examples:

```text
static/js/*.js
static/admin/js/*.js
static/css/*.css
static/admin/css/*.css
```

Run:

```bash
python manage.py collectstatic
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
```

Browser:

```text
hard refresh
clear cache if old behavior remains
```

### [DECISION] If `.env` Changed

Run:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
```

Reason:

```text
Environment is loaded at process start.
Running services do not automatically see changed .env values.
```

### [DECISION] If Systemd Service Changed

Run:

```bash
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart SERVICE_NAME
sudo systemctl status SERVICE_NAME
```

Example:

```bash
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
sudo systemctl status lms_scheduler
```

### [DECISION] If Requirements Changed

Run:

```bash
source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py check
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
```

### [DECISION] If Nginx Config Changed

Run:

```bash
sudo nginx -t
sudo systemctl reload nginx
sudo systemctl status nginx
```

### [DECISION] If Backup/Restore Code Changed

Run:

```bash
python manage.py check
which pg_dump
which psql
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
```

Then test one manual backup from admin or shell.

## [SECTION] 7. Known Production Issues

### [ISSUE] `pg_dump` Missing In Service PATH

Symptom:

```text
BACKUP | FAILED | Error: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'pg_dump'
```

Cause:

```text
pg_dump existed for SSH user, but gunicorn/lms_scheduler service PATH only had venv/bin.
```

Fix:

```text
Add systemd PATH override including /usr/bin.
Restart service.
```

Verify:

```bash
sudo systemctl show gunicorn -p Environment
sudo systemctl show lms_scheduler -p Environment
```

### [ISSUE] Zero Byte Raw `.sql` Backup Files

Symptom:

```text
backup_prod_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.sql size 0
```

Cause:

```text
Backup created raw file before pg_dump failed.
```

Fix:

```text
manage_backups.py cleanup removes incomplete raw backup after failure.
```

### [ISSUE] PostgreSQL `FOR UPDATE` Nullable Join

Symptom:

```text
FOR UPDATE cannot be applied to the nullable side of an outer join
```

Cause:

```text
select_for_update() tried to lock Leave plus nullable user__profile outer join.
```

Fix:

```python
Leave.objects.select_for_update(of=("self",)).select_related("user", "user__profile")
```

Why safe:

```text
Leave row is still locked.
User/profile can still be read.
PostgreSQL no longer tries to lock nullable profile join.
```

### [ISSUE] Static JS/CSS Not Updating

Symptom:

```text
old eye toggle behavior
old notification symbol code
old admin job status behavior
```

Cause:

```text
staticfiles still had old JS/CSS or browser cache held old file.
```

Fix:

```bash
python manage.py collectstatic
sudo systemctl restart gunicorn
```

Then hard refresh browser.

### [ISSUE] qcluster Stopped

Symptom:

```text
Admin email job remains queued/running.
Background email not sent.
Weekly report not processed.
```

Fix:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart qcluster
sudo systemctl status qcluster
```

Recovery:

```text
AdminEmailJob stale recovery can requeue old running jobs.
lms_scheduler runs recovery every 5 minutes.
```

### [ISSUE] Scheduler Backup Did Not Run

Symptom:

```text
No backup for date.
lms_scheduler not active or backup failed.
```

Check:

```bash
sudo systemctl status lms_scheduler
sudo journalctl -u lms_scheduler --since "YYYY-MM-DD 01:55:00" --no-pager
```

Fix:

```bash
sudo systemctl restart lms_scheduler
```

### [ISSUE] Browser Push Notification Not Working

Cause checklist:

```text
HTTPS missing
service worker missing
browser permission denied
subscription inactive
push keys wrong
tab not open/polling for in-app sound
```

Production status:

```text
HTTPS was added and tested.
```

### [ISSUE] Email Sent But Admin Shows N/A

Cause:

```text
EmailDeliveryLog not connected to display logic or no matching log query.
```

Expected fixed display:

```text
Sent - 26/05/2026 (2 times)
```

### [ISSUE] Admin Email Job Page Needed Manual Refresh

Cause:

```text
auto polling JS/static not loaded or endpoint not updating.
```

Fix:

```text
static admin_email_job_status.js and admin change form must be deployed.
collectstatic must run.
```

## [SECTION] 9. Security Checklist

### [SECURITY] Secrets

Check:

```text
.env should not be committed.
webpush private key should not be committed.
database password should not be exposed in docs.
email password/app password should not be exposed.
```

### [SECURITY] HTTPS

Required for:

```text
secure cookies
service worker
browser push notifications
safe login
```

Check:

```text
Production URL opens with https.
No mixed content warnings.
```

### [SECURITY] CSRF

Check:

```text
POST forms include csrf_token.
AJAX POST sends CSRF token.
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS includes production domain if needed.
```

Important:

```text
Do not disable CSRF to fix a page.
Find the missing token or trusted origin problem.
```

### [SECURITY] Role Enforcement

Check:

```text
Server-side views validate role.
API endpoints validate role.
Templates do not rely only on hidden buttons.
```

### [SECURITY] Admin Audit

Sensitive actions should be auditable:

```text
user activation/deactivation
force password
login lock/unlock
leave changes
backup restore
communication edits/deletes
balance adjustments
```

### [SECURITY] Restore Safety

Restore must require:

```text
admin login
exact confirmation
reason
maintenance window
valid backup path
no arbitrary file path
```

### [SECURITY] Backup Safety

Backups should:

```text
be stored outside public web root
not be served by nginx
not include zero-byte failed files as valid backups
be checked regularly
```

### [SECURITY] Login Lock

Check:

```text
wrong password attempts lock account after threshold
lock duration is clear
admin lock/unlock is audited
emails do not expose sensitive internal details
```

### [SECURITY] File Uploads

Profile photos/media should:

```text
use safe storage paths
not allow executable uploads
be served by nginx as media
not expose private files
```

### [SECURITY] Logs

Logs should not include:

```text
passwords
reset tokens
email app passwords
database credentials
private keys
```

## [SECTION] 10. Performance Guide

### [PERFORMANCE] Slow Page Checklist

Ask:

```text
Is the page doing many database queries?
Is the page loading old/large static files?
Is the page waiting for email/PDF/network?
Is a background task accidentally running inside request?
Is browser making many API calls?
```

Check logs:

```bash
sudo journalctl -u gunicorn -n 120 --no-pager
```

### [PERFORMANCE] Admin User List

Risk:

```text
Counting email logs per user row can become slow for thousands of users.
```

Better approach:

```text
Annotate counts in queryset.
Only calculate for rows on current page.
Use DB aggregation instead of one query per row.
```

### [PERFORMANCE] qcluster Workers

Current idea:

```text
qcluster handles queued/background tasks.
More workers can process more tasks in parallel.
```

Impact of increasing workers:

```text
more CPU usage
more DB connections
more memory
faster queue processing
possible contention if too high
```

Rule:

```text
Increase only if CPU/RAM/DB can handle it.
Monitor after change.
```

### [PERFORMANCE] ThreadPoolExecutor Fallback

Purpose:

```text
Fallback helps when qcluster is unavailable.
It runs background work in the web process.
```

Risk:

```text
If gunicorn restarts, fallback in-memory work can be lost.
It is not as durable as qcluster.
```

Best use:

```text
short emergency fallback
not primary job system
```

### [PERFORMANCE] Scheduler

Scheduler runs:

```text
year_end_carry_forward daily 01:00
nightly_backup daily 02:00
weekly_hr_report Monday 09:00
public_holiday_sync monthly day 1 03:00
admin_email_job_recovery every 5 minutes
scheduler_keepalive every 6 hours
```

Performance note:

```text
Every 5 minute recovery is light because it checks only stale admin email jobs.
It should not slow normal pages.
```

### [PERFORMANCE] Static Files

Do:

```text
run collectstatic after JS/CSS changes
use browser hard refresh when testing
avoid huge unused JS bundles
```

### [PERFORMANCE] Database Queries

Common improvements:

```text
select_related for foreign keys/one-to-one
prefetch_related for many-to-many/reverse relationships
annotate for counts
indexes for frequent filters
pagination for large lists
```

Caution:

```text
select_for_update with nullable joins can break on PostgreSQL.
Use of=("self",) when locking only the main row.
```

### [PERFORMANCE] Email Sending

Do:

```text
send bulk email through qcluster
track each user with AdminEmailJobItem
do not block admin page while sending many emails
```

Admin page message should say:

```text
Email queued or scheduled
```

Final sent/failed result should be shown on job status page.

### [PERFORMANCE] Logs

Large logs can slow manual diagnosis.

Use:

```bash
sudo journalctl -u gunicorn -n 120 --no-pager
sudo journalctl -u qcluster -n 120 --no-pager
sudo journalctl -u lms_scheduler -n 120 --no-pager
```

Avoid:

```text
dumping thousands of lines unless needed
```

### [PERFORMANCE] Browser Polling

Polling powers:

```text
communication dropdown refresh
notification sound checks
admin email job live status
```

Risk:

```text
Too many open tabs/users can create many repeated API calls.
```

Monitor:

```text
gunicorn logs
network tab
API response times
```

### [PERFORMANCE] Production Rule

When something feels slow:

```text
1. Identify exact page/API.
2. Check browser network time.
3. Check gunicorn logs.
4. Check DB query pattern in code.
5. Check if background work is running in request.
6. Move heavy work to qcluster if needed.
7. Add pagination/aggregation if list is large.
```
